fullDescription: A bold, dark, editorial agency-studio homepage: near-black noir #0c0c0c surfaces with a single acid-lime #c4ff00 accent and off-white #f5f5f0 text. A pill-shaped floating glass nav, a massive Anton condensed-uppercase hero headline ('WE BUILD BOLD brands ONLINE.') with an italic Archivo 'brands' in lime, an infinite-scroll keyword marquee, a stat-counter studio statement, a 2-column rounded-card 'selected work' grid with hover reveals, a hover-fill numbered services list, a clients/awards logo grid, a huge centered CTA, and a 4-column footer with a newsletter input. Anton + Archivo + Inter, lime-on-noir, award-site energy.
prompt: ## Resumo A bold, dark, award-site agency/studio homepage in near-monochrome noir #0c0c0c with a single acid-lime #c4ff00 accent and off-white #f5f5f0 text. A floating pill glass nav sits above a grain-textured hero whose massive Anton condensed all-caps headline ('WE BUILD BOLD brands ONLINE.') tucks an italic lime Archivo 'brands' inline, lit by a single soft lime glow, and capped by a full-bleed infinite keyword marquee (lime '✦' separators). Below: a studio statement with a 4-up stat-counter row (120+ / 14 / 98% / 5), a 2-column selected-work grid of rounded-2xl image cards with hover-reveal gradient meta + lime arrow circles (plus a wide featured card and a coal 'view all' card), a numbered services list whose full-width rows flip to a solid lime fill on hover, a clients/awards block with award pills and a hairline logo grid, a huge centered CTA ('Got a brand to launch?'), and a 4-column footer with a lime newsletter pill. The signature is restraint + one electric accent: noir surfaces split by white/10 hairlines, depth from SVG grain and a lone lime/10 blur (no second hue), Anton + Archivo + Inter doing the shouting, and lime rationed to pills, the logo diamond, index eyebrows, one word per headline, arrows, and interaction states. Awwwards-SOTD studio energy. ## Estilo Visual Dark editorial agency/studio landing page, near-monochrome noir + a single acid-lime accent. Exact palette via tailwind.config theme.extend.colors: noir #0c0c0c (page bg), coal #141414 (ticker / footer / 'view all' card / awards cells bg), slate2 #1c1c1c (work-card bg), off #f5f5f0 (primary text), lime #c4ff00 (the ONLY accent). body { background:#0c0c0c; color:#f5f5f0; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased } and class overflow-x-hidden. Text opacity ladder on off-white: text-off (primary), text-off/80 (lead), text-off/70 (nav links / footer links), text-off/65 /55 /50 /45 /40 /35 /30 (secondary, captions, eyebrows, muted display words). Borders are border-white/10 hairlines (and border-white/15-/20 on pills/chips). The accent is strictly lime #c4ff00: never introduce any other hue. Use it for: bg-lime pill buttons with text-noir; the rotated-diamond logo glyph; '✦' marquee stars and the footer star; section index eyebrows like '(Studio / 01)' (text-lime, text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em]); one emphasized word per headline (text-lime); the work-card arrow circles (bg-lime text-noir); the hover fill of services rows; the '+' / '%' stat suffixes; and the animated link-underline. Atmosphere helpers: .grain::before is an absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-0.04 SVG fractalNoise turbulence overlay; the hero also has a single pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 top-10 h-[480px] w-[480px] rounded-full bg-lime/10 blur-[120px] glow. ::selection { background:#c4ff00; color:#0c0c0c }. html { scroll-behavior:smooth }. Icons are Iconify Lucide (lucide:arrow-up-right, lucide:arrow-right, lucide:award, lucide:trophy, lucide:star, lucide:calendar) loaded via the iconify web component script. Built with Tailwind CDN. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Floating pill nav (fixed) A fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 header whose inner mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8 holds a single rounded-full pill bar: nav mt-4 flex items-center justify-between rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-noir/70 px-4 py-2.5 -> md:px-6 md:py-3 backdrop-blur-xl (a floating glass capsule, NOT a full-width bar). Left = brand lockup: a 7x7 rounded-full bg-lime circle containing a 2.5x2.5 rotate-45 bg-noir square (the diamond mark), beside the wordmark 'VOLTKIND' in .archivo-tight text-[17px] font-800 tracking-tight with a trailing text-lime '.'. Center (hidden lg:flex, gap-8, text-[13px] font-medium tracking-wide text-off/70): Work / Studio / Services / Clients, each .link-underline hover:text-off. Right = a .pill-btn rounded-full bg-lime px-5 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-700 uppercase tracking-wide text-noir hover:bg-off 'Start a project'. ### Hero section relative .grain overflow-hidden pt-32 -> md:pt-40 with a pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 top-10 h-[480px] w-[480px] rounded-full bg-lime/10 blur-[120px] glow. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8: an eyebrow row (flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-off/55) = a h-px w-8 bg-lime hairline + 'Independent design studio · Est. 2021'. Then the signature H1: class 'display mt-6 text-[clamp(3.4rem,15.5vw,15rem)] text-off' reading 'WE BUILD' / (block) 'BOLD' with an inline .script-accent text-lime 'brands' at font-size:0.6em text-transform:none letter-spacing:-0.01em margin-left:0.12em / (block) 'ONLINE' + a text-lime '.'. Below (mt-10 grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 border-t border-white/10 pt-8 -> md:grid-cols-12 md:items-end): a lead paragraph (.archivo-tight text-[19px] -> md:text-[22px] font-medium leading-snug text-off/80, md:col-span-7) 'VOLTKIND is a digital design studio crafting websites, brand systems, and interfaces that make people stop scrolling and start trusting. Strategy first, pixels that punch.'; and a md:col-span-5 right-aligned CTA cluster of two pills: a .pill-btn bg-off text-noir 'View selected work' with a lucide:arrow-up-right (hover:bg-lime), and a .pill-btn border border-white/20 text-off 'Book a call' (hover:border-lime hover:text-lime), both rounded-full px-6 py-3.5 text-[14px] uppercase tracking-wide. ### Keyword marquee strip Directly under the hero, mt-16 overflow-hidden border-y border-white/10 bg-coal py-4. Inside a .marquee flex w-max items-center gap-10 whitespace-nowrap that animates via @keyframes marquee { from translateX(0) to translateX(-50%) } animation:28s linear infinite. The track contains the keyword list TWICE (the second copy aria-hidden) for a seamless loop: each copy is a flex items-center gap-10 text-[15px] font-700 uppercase tracking-wide text-off/70 of 'Web Design' / 'Brand Identity' / 'Webflow & Framer' / 'UI / UX' / 'Art Direction' / 'Motion', separated by text-lime '✦' stars. ### Studio statement + stat counters section id=studio relative py-24 -> md:py-36; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8; a grid grid-cols-1 gap-12 -> md:grid-cols-12. Left (md:col-span-3): a text-lime eyebrow '(Studio / 01)' (text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em]) + a small text-off/55 note 'A small senior team. No account-manager telephone game, you work with the people drawing the pixels.'. Right (md:col-span-9): an H2 .archivo-tight text-[clamp(1.7rem,4.6vw,3.6rem)] font-800 leading-[1.05] 'We design digital experiences with [unwavering in text-off/35] precision and [relentless in text-lime] creativity, to elevate brands and inspire the audiences worth winning.'. Below it a stat row: mt-14 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-10 border-t border-white/10 pt-10 -> md:grid-cols-4, four cells each = a .display text-[clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4rem)] number with a lime/off suffix + a mt-2 text-[13px] uppercase tracking-wide text-off/50 label: '120+ Projects shipped' (the '+' off, the number lime), '14 Design awards', '98% Client retention' (the '%' lime), '5 Years independent'. ### Selected work grid section id=work relative pb-24 -> md:pb-36; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8. Header (mb-10 -> md:mb-14 flex flex-col gap-4 -> md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between): left = a text-lime eyebrow '(Selected work / 02)' + an H2 .display text-[clamp(2.6rem,8vw,6rem)] 'Recent [drops in text-off/30]'; right = a max-w-sm text-[15px] text-off/55 blurb. Then a grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 -> md:grid-cols-2 of cards. Each standard card = an .work-card group relative block overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-slate2 with: an aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden image (.card-img object-cover from Unsplash) that on .work-card:hover scales 1.05 + saturates; an absolute inset-0 .card-meta hover-reveal panel (bg-gradient-to-t from-noir/90 via-noir/20 to-transparent p-6, opacity-0 translate-y-3 -> opacity-100 translate-y-0 on hover) holding a big .archivo-tight title + a category line + an 11x11 rounded-full bg-lime text-noir arrow circle (lucide:arrow-up-right); and an always-visible bottom label row (px-6 py-5) = a .archivo-tight text-[20px] font-800 title + a tiny uppercase year + a rounded-full border border-white/15 tag chip. Four such cards: 'Zenith Motors / Brand identity · 2026 / Automotive', 'Growth Analytics / Product UI · 2026 / SaaS', a WIDE card 'Halcyon Architecture' (md:col-span-2, aspect-[16/9] -> md:aspect-[21/8], larger type, 'Editorial site · 2025 / Featured'), 'Peachnest / E-commerce · 2025 / Retail'. Plus a final 'view all' card = a .work-card flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-coal p-8 -> md:p-10 hover:border-lime: an 'Archive' label + a lucide:arrow-up-right that group-hover:rotate-45, then a .display text-[clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.5rem)] 'View all [projects in text-lime]' + a blurb. ### Services list (hover-fill rows) section id=services relative border-t border-white/10 py-24 -> md:py-32; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8. Header (mb-12 grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 -> md:grid-cols-12 md:items-end): md:col-span-8 = a text-lime eyebrow '(Services / 03)' + an H2 .display text-[clamp(2.6rem,8vw,6rem)] 'What we [do in text-off/30]'; md:col-span-4 = a text-[15px] text-off/55 blurb. Then a border-t border-white/10 list of four .svc-row group rows: each = grid grid-cols-12 items-center gap-4 border-b border-white/10 px-2 py-7 -> md:px-6 md:py-9, containing a .svc-num col-span-2 -> md:col-span-1 text-[14px] font-700 text-off/35 index ('01'-'04'), a .archivo-tight col-span-10 -> md:col-span-5 text-[clamp(1.6rem,3.4vw,2.6rem)] font-800 title, a .svc-tags col-span-12 -> md:col-span-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2 of rounded-full border border-white/20 text-[12px] uppercase tag chips, and a hidden md:flex md:col-span-1 justify-end .svc-arrow lucide:arrow-right. The signature interaction: .svc-row:hover { background:#c4ff00; color:#0c0c0c } and on hover the index, arrow, and tag chip borders/text all flip to noir. Rows: '01 Web & Product Design [Figma / Design Systems / Prototyping]', '02 Brand Identity [Logo & Marks / Type / Guidelines]', '03 Webflow & Framer Build [No-code / CMS / SEO]', '04 Motion & Art Direction [Animation / 3D / Campaign]'. ### Clients / awards section id=clients relative border-t border-white/10 py-20 -> md:py-28; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8. Header (flex flex-col gap-4 -> md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between): left = a text-lime eyebrow '(Trusted by / 04)' + an H2 .archivo-tight text-[clamp(1.6rem,3.6vw,2.8rem)] font-800 'Brands and juries that kept us busy.'; right = a flex flex-wrap gap-3 of three award pills (rounded-full border ... px-4 py-2 text-[12px] uppercase) each with a lucide icon: a lime-bordered/lime-text 'Awwwards · SOTD ×6' (lucide:award), then white/15-bordered off/60 'CSS Design · ×4' (lucide:trophy) and 'FWA · ×4' (lucide:star). Below: a logo grid mt-12 grid grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-4 -> lg:grid-cols-6 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/10 (so gap-px reads as hairline dividers); each cell is a flex items-center justify-center bg-noir py-10 with a .archivo-tight text-[22px] font-800 text-off/55 wordmark (Northwind, Lumio, Cobalt, Verdant, Atlas, Keystone, Halo Labs, Driftwood, Monocle, Pivot, Solace) and a final text-lime '+ you' cell. ### Contact CTA section id=contact relative .grain overflow-hidden border-t border-white/10 py-28 -> md:py-40; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8; text-center. A text-lime eyebrow '(Let''s build / 05)', then a huge H2 .display mx-auto mt-6 max-w-[14ch] text-[clamp(3rem,12vw,11rem)] 'Got a brand' / (block) 'to [launch? in text-lime]', a mx-auto mt-8 max-w-xl text-[17px] text-off/65 subline 'Tell us where you want to be and we''ll map the design to get you there. First reply within a day, no sales-y nonsense.', and a CTA row (mt-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 -> sm:flex-row): a .pill-btn bg-lime text-noir 'hello@voltkind.studio' mailto pill with a lucide:arrow-up-right (hover:bg-off), and a .pill-btn border border-white/20 text-off 'Book a 20-min intro' pill with a lucide:calendar (hover:border-lime hover:text-lime), both rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-[15px] uppercase tracking-wide. ### Footer (4-column + newsletter) footer border-t border-white/10 bg-coal; inner mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 py-16 -> md:px-8. A grid grid-cols-1 gap-12 -> md:grid-cols-12: (md:col-span-5) the brand lockup repeated (lime diamond circle + 'VOLTKIND.' .archivo-tight font-800) + a max-w-sm text-[15px] text-off/55 blurb + a status line 'Booking projects for Q3 2026' with a h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-lime dot; (md:col-span-2) a 'Studio' column (text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-off/40 heading + a space-y-2.5 list of text-off/70 .link-underline links Work/About/Services/Contact); (md:col-span-2) a 'Social' column (Instagram/Dribbble/X-Twitter/LinkedIn); (md:col-span-3) a 'Get the brief' column with a note + a newsletter form = a flex overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-white/15 with a transparent email input and a bg-lime text-noir submit button (lucide:arrow-right, hover:bg-off). Bottom: a mt-14 flex flex-col -> md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-white/10 pt-7 text-[13px] text-off/40 row = '© 2026 Voltkind Studio. All rights reserved.' / 'Designed in the dark, built for the light.' with a text-lime '✦' / 'Privacy · Terms'. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Anton condensed display headline with an italic lime script word (.display + .script-accent) — The page's whole identity: enormous condensed all-caps Anton headlines (hero 'WE BUILD BOLD brands ONLINE.', the CTA 'Got a brand to launch?') with one word swapped to an italic, heavy, lime Archivo word tucked inline at 0.6em, mixing brutalist scale with a handwritten-feeling pop. Define .display { font-family:'Anton',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:0.86; text-transform:uppercase } and .script-accent { font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-style:italic; font-weight:800 }. Set the hero H1 to .display text-[clamp(3.4rem,15.5vw,15rem)] text-off across three lines, and inside it place a brands. Reuse .display for the big section headers and the CTA (text-[clamp(3rem,12vw,11rem)]), always with one word in text-lime or text-off/30. ### Lime pill button (.pill-btn) — The one filled control style: fully-rounded pills that lift on hover, used in the nav ('Start a project'), the hero ('View selected work'), and the CTA ('hello@...'); the secondary variant is a bordered ghost pill that turns lime on hover. Build .pill-btn { transition:transform .3s ease, background .3s ease, color .3s ease } and .pill-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px) }. Primary = rounded-full bg-lime text-noir font-700 uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-off (sizes px-5 py-2.5 in nav, px-6 py-3.5 in hero, px-8 py-4 in CTA). Secondary/ghost = rounded-full border border-white/20 text-off font-600 hover:border-lime hover:text-lime. Never color it any hue but lime. ### Hover-reveal work cards (.work-card / .card-img / .card-meta) — Rounded-2xl portfolio image cards where the photo scales on hover while a dark gradient meta panel slides up to reveal the project title and a lime arrow circle; below the image an always-visible label row keeps the card readable at rest and in screenshots. Card = . Image wrapper aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden with .card-img { transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), filter .6s ease } and .work-card:hover .card-img { transform:scale(1.05); filter:saturate(1.1) brightness(.92) }. Overlay = .card-meta absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-noir/90 via-noir/20 to-transparent p-6, with .card-meta { transition:opacity .45s ease, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) }, starting opacity-0 translate-y-3 and going opacity-100 translate-y-0 on .work-card:hover; it holds a big .archivo-tight title, a category line, and an h-11 w-11 rounded-full bg-lime text-noir lucide:arrow-up-right circle. Keep a separate always-visible px-6 py-5 label row beneath the image. ### Hover-fill services rows (.svc-row) + animated link underline (.link-underline) — Full-width numbered service rows that flip to a solid lime fill with noir text on hover (index, arrow, and tag-chip borders all invert), plus a reusable lime underline that wipes in from the left under text links. Rows: .svc-row { transition:background .35s ease, padding .35s ease } and .svc-row:hover { background:#c4ff00; color:#0c0c0c }; on hover also flip children: .svc-row:hover .svc-num, .svc-row:hover .svc-arrow { color:#0c0c0c } and .svc-row:hover .svc-tags span { border-color:#0c0c0c; color:#0c0c0c }. Links: .link-underline { background-image:linear-gradient(#c4ff00,#c4ff00); background-size:0% 2px; background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:0 100%; transition:background-size .4s ease } and .link-underline:hover { background-size:100% 2px }. ### Infinite keyword marquee (.marquee) — A full-bleed coal band of capability keywords separated by lime '✦' stars that scrolls horizontally forever; the keyword list is duplicated so the loop is seamless. Wrapper overflow-hidden border-y border-white/10 bg-coal py-4. Track = .marquee flex w-max items-center gap-10 whitespace-nowrap with .marquee { animation:marquee 28s linear infinite } and @keyframes marquee { from { transform:translateX(0) } to { transform:translateX(-50%) } }. Put the same flex group of keyword spans (text-[15px] font-700 uppercase tracking-wide text-off/70) TWICE inside the track, the second copy aria-hidden, with text-lime '✦' separators. ### Atmospheric grain + lime glow — Texture instead of color: a faint SVG fractal-noise grain overlay on the hero and CTA sections, plus a single soft lime radial glow behind the hero, giving depth on the near-black canvas without adding a second hue. .grain::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:0.04; z-index:1; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,...feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency=0.9 numOctaves=3...") } applied to the hero and contact sections. The hero also gets a pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 top-10 h-[480px] w-[480px] rounded-full bg-lime/10 blur-[120px] glow. No colored gradients beyond lime/10. ## Notas Especiais Frameless, fully responsive dark agency/studio marketing homepage (no browser chrome / no device frame). Every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1320px] with px-5 -> md:px-8 and sections are split by 1px border-white/10 hairlines. Built with the Tailwind CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering custom colors (noir #0c0c0c, coal #141414, slate2 #1c1c1c, off #f5f5f0, lime #c4ff00) and the three font families (Anton, Archivo, Inter); Google Fonts loads Anton + Archivo 400-900 + Inter 300-700; icons are Iconify Lucide (lucide:) glyphs via the iconify web component. Responsive contract: the floating pill nav drops its center links below lg; the hero copy row is grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-12 (lead col-span-7, CTAs col-span-5 right-aligned); the studio block is 1 -> md:grid-cols-12 with stats grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-4; the work grid is 1 -> md:grid-cols-2 (the wide card md:col-span-2, aspect-[16/9] -> md:aspect-[21/8]); service rows stay a 12-col grid that stacks tags below the title on mobile; the awards grid is grid-cols-2 -> md:4 -> lg:6; the footer is 1 -> md:grid-cols-12 (5/2/2/3); body is overflow-x-hidden. All copy and the 'VOLTKIND' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped. The transferable library value is (1) the STYLE: a near-monochrome noir #0c0c0c canvas with off-white #f5f5f0 text and a SINGLE rationed acid-lime #c4ff00 accent (pills, logo diamond, '✦' stars, section index eyebrows, one word per headline, work-card arrows, the services hover-fill, stat suffixes, the link-underline), atmosphere from SVG grain + one lime/10 blur glow rather than extra color; and (2) the LAYOUT: a floating pill glass nav -> grain hero with an Anton condensed headline + inline italic lime script word + a keyword marquee -> stat-counter studio statement -> 2-col rounded-card work grid with hover-reveal meta -> hover-fill numbered services list -> awards/clients hairline logo grid -> huge centered CTA -> 4-column footer with a newsletter pill. Strictly one accent hue (lime): never introduce red/blue/violet.

style.description: A confident, award-site agency aesthetic: near-black 'noir' canvas with a single high-voltage acid-lime accent and warm off-white text, so the page reads as monochrome dark + one electric pop. The whole layout is built from full-bleed dark sections separated by 1px white/10 hairline borders rather than color blocks; depth comes from a faint SVG grain overlay and a single soft lime radial glow behind the hero, not from gradients of color. Type does the shouting: an Anton condensed all-caps display face at huge clamp() sizes with tight tracking and 0.86 line-height for the hero/section headers, an Archivo tight-tracked heavy face for sub-display and card titles, and Inter for body. The lone accent #c4ff00 is rationed: it fills the primary pill buttons (lime bg, noir text), the small rotated-diamond logo mark, the '✦' marquee separators, the section index labels '(Studio / 01)', one or two words inside each headline, the work-card arrow circles, and the hover state of the services rows (a row flips to a full lime fill with noir text). Interactions are tactile: pill buttons lift on hover, work-card images scale + a dark gradient meta panel slides up, an animated link-underline wipes in lime, and a keyword marquee scrolls infinitely. Rounded-2xl cards and fully-rounded pills against hard-edged sections give a studio-portfolio, Awwwards-SOTD feel.

Atmosphere helpers: .grain::before is an absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-0.04 SVG fractalNoise turbulence overlay; the hero also has a single pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 top-10 h-[480px] w-[480px] rounded-full bg-lime/10 blur-[120px] glow. ::selection { background:#c4ff00; color:#0c0c0c }. html { scroll-behavior:smooth }. style.prompt_typography: Three Google fonts: Anton (display), Archivo (300-900, sub-display/cards/lead), Inter (300-700, body). .display { font-family:'Anton'; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:0.86; text-transform:uppercase } used for the hero H1, the big section headers ('Recent drops', 'What we do'), the stat counters, the 'View all projects' card, and the CTA headline. .archivo-tight { font-family:'Archivo'; letter-spacing:-0.02em } used for the wordmark, the studio-statement H2, work-card titles, service-row titles, awards/clients wordmarks. .script-accent { font-family:'Archivo'; font-style:italic; font-weight:800 } is the signature flourish: the italic lime word ('brands') tucked into the hero headline at font-size:0.6em, text-transform:none, margin-left:0.12em. Body copy is Inter via the body font-family. Sizing leans on clamp(): hero H1 text-[clamp(3.4rem,15.5vw,15rem)]; the CTA headline text-[clamp(3rem,12vw,11rem)]; big section headers text-[clamp(2.6rem,8vw,6rem)]; studio H2 text-[clamp(1.7rem,4.6vw,3.6rem)] font-800; stat numbers text-[clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4rem)]; service-row titles text-[clamp(1.6rem,3.4vw,2.6rem)] font-800. Eyebrows are text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em]; nav links text-[13px] font-medium tracking-wide; body/lead 14-22px.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, vertically stacked, frameless responsive marketing page; almost every section centers inside mx-auto max-w-[1320px] with px-5 -> md:px-8. Order top to bottom: a FIXED floating pill nav (mt-4 rounded-full glass bar, not a full-width bar); a HERO (grain + lime glow, an eyebrow with a short lime hairline, the massive Anton headline, then a 12-col row splitting a lead paragraph from two pill CTAs) capped by a full-bleed infinite keyword MARQUEE strip on a coal band; a STUDIO STATEMENT (3-col label + 9-col big Archivo statement with two emphasized words, then a 4-up stat-counter row); a SELECTED WORK grid (section header split, then a 2-col grid of rounded-2xl image cards with hover-reveal meta + one full-width wide card + a coal 'view all projects' card); a SERVICES list (header split, then 4 full-width 12-col rows divided by hairlines that fill lime on hover, each = index + Archivo title + tag chips + arrow); a CLIENTS/AWARDS block (header + award pills, then a 2/4/6-col bordered logo grid with gap-px hairline cells); a centered CONTACT CTA (grain, huge Anton headline, subcopy, two pills); and a 4-column FOOTER (brand + blurb + 'booking' status, two link columns, a newsletter input pill) with a bottom legal row. Reflow: the floating nav links hide below lg (the pill keeps logo + 'Start a project'); the hero copy row is grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-12 (lead col-span-7, CTAs col-span-5 right-aligned); the studio block is 1 -> md:grid-cols-12 and the stats are grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-4; the work grid is grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 with the wide card spanning md:col-span-2 and switching aspect-[16/9] -> md:aspect-[21/8]; service rows are a fixed 12-col grid that stacks tags below the title on mobile; the awards grid is grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-4 -> lg:grid-cols-6; the footer is grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-12 (5/2/2/3). Everything collapses to one column on mobile; overflow-x is clipped on body.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 header whose inner mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8 holds a single rounded-full pill bar: nav mt-4 flex items-center justify-between rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-noir/70 px-4 py-2.5 -> md:px-6 md:py-3 backdrop-blur-xl (a floating glass capsule, NOT a full-width bar). Left = brand lockup: a 7x7 rounded-full bg-lime circle containing a 2.5x2.5 rotate-45 bg-noir square (the diamond mark), beside the wordmark 'VOLTKIND' in .archivo-tight text-[17px] font-800 tracking-tight with a trailing text-lime '.'. Center (hidden lg:flex, gap-8, text-[13px] font-medium tracking-wide text-off/70): Work / Studio / Services / Clients, each .link-underline hover:text-off. Right = a .pill-btn rounded-full bg-lime px-5 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-700 uppercase tracking-wide text-noir hover:bg-off 'Start a project'.

section relative .grain overflow-hidden pt-32 -> md:pt-40 with a pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 top-10 h-[480px] w-[480px] rounded-full bg-lime/10 blur-[120px] glow. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8: an eyebrow row (flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-off/55) = a h-px w-8 bg-lime hairline + 'Independent design studio · Est. 2021'. Then the signature H1: class 'display mt-6 text-[clamp(3.4rem,15.5vw,15rem)] text-off' reading 'WE BUILD' / (block) 'BOLD' with an inline .script-accent text-lime 'brands' at font-size:0.6em text-transform:none letter-spacing:-0.01em margin-left:0.12em / (block) 'ONLINE' + a text-lime '.'. Below (mt-10 grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 border-t border-white/10 pt-8 -> md:grid-cols-12 md:items-end): a lead paragraph (.archivo-tight text-[19px] -> md:text-[22px] font-medium leading-snug text-off/80, md:col-span-7) 'VOLTKIND is a digital design studio crafting websites, brand systems, and interfaces that make people stop scrolling and start trusting. Strategy first, pixels that punch.'; and a md:col-span-5 right-aligned CTA cluster of two pills: a .pill-btn bg-off text-noir 'View selected work' with a lucide:arrow-up-right (hover:bg-lime), and a .pill-btn border border-white/20 text-off 'Book a call' (hover:border-lime hover:text-lime), both rounded-full px-6 py-3.5 text-[14px] uppercase tracking-wide.

Directly under the hero, mt-16 overflow-hidden border-y border-white/10 bg-coal py-4. Inside a .marquee flex w-max items-center gap-10 whitespace-nowrap that animates via @keyframes marquee { from translateX(0) to translateX(-50%) } animation:28s linear infinite. The track contains the keyword list TWICE (the second copy aria-hidden) for a seamless loop: each copy is a flex items-center gap-10 text-[15px] font-700 uppercase tracking-wide text-off/70 of 'Web Design' / 'Brand Identity' / 'Webflow & Framer' / 'UI / UX' / 'Art Direction' / 'Motion', separated by text-lime '✦' stars.

section id=studio relative py-24 -> md:py-36; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8; a grid grid-cols-1 gap-12 -> md:grid-cols-12. Left (md:col-span-3): a text-lime eyebrow '(Studio / 01)' (text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em]) + a small text-off/55 note 'A small senior team. No account-manager telephone game, you work with the people drawing the pixels.'. Right (md:col-span-9): an H2 .archivo-tight text-[clamp(1.7rem,4.6vw,3.6rem)] font-800 leading-[1.05] 'We design digital experiences with [unwavering in text-off/35] precision and [relentless in text-lime] creativity, to elevate brands and inspire the audiences worth winning.'. Below it a stat row: mt-14 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-10 border-t border-white/10 pt-10 -> md:grid-cols-4, four cells each = a .display text-[clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4rem)] number with a lime/off suffix + a mt-2 text-[13px] uppercase tracking-wide text-off/50 label: '120+ Projects shipped' (the '+' off, the number lime), '14 Design awards', '98% Client retention' (the '%' lime), '5 Years independent'.

section id=work relative pb-24 -> md:pb-36; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8. Header (mb-10 -> md:mb-14 flex flex-col gap-4 -> md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between): left = a text-lime eyebrow '(Selected work / 02)' + an H2 .display text-[clamp(2.6rem,8vw,6rem)] 'Recent [drops in text-off/30]'; right = a max-w-sm text-[15px] text-off/55 blurb. Then a grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 -> md:grid-cols-2 of cards. Each standard card = an <a> .work-card group relative block overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-slate2 with: an aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden image (.card-img object-cover from Unsplash) that on .work-card:hover scales 1.05 + saturates; an absolute inset-0 .card-meta hover-reveal panel (bg-gradient-to-t from-noir/90 via-noir/20 to-transparent p-6, opacity-0 translate-y-3 -> opacity-100 translate-y-0 on hover) holding a big .archivo-tight title + a category line + an 11x11 rounded-full bg-lime text-noir arrow circle (lucide:arrow-up-right); and an always-visible bottom label row (px-6 py-5) = a .archivo-tight text-[20px] font-800 title + a tiny uppercase year + a rounded-full border border-white/15 tag chip. Four such cards: 'Zenith Motors / Brand identity · 2026 / Automotive', 'Growth Analytics / Product UI · 2026 / SaaS', a WIDE card 'Halcyon Architecture' (md:col-span-2, aspect-[16/9] -> md:aspect-[21/8], larger type, 'Editorial site · 2025 / Featured'), 'Peachnest / E-commerce · 2025 / Retail'. Plus a final 'view all' card = a .work-card flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-coal p-8 -> md:p-10 hover:border-lime: an 'Archive' label + a lucide:arrow-up-right that group-hover:rotate-45, then a .display text-[clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.5rem)] 'View all [projects in text-lime]' + a blurb.

section id=services relative border-t border-white/10 py-24 -> md:py-32; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8. Header (mb-12 grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 -> md:grid-cols-12 md:items-end): md:col-span-8 = a text-lime eyebrow '(Services / 03)' + an H2 .display text-[clamp(2.6rem,8vw,6rem)] 'What we [do in text-off/30]'; md:col-span-4 = a text-[15px] text-off/55 blurb. Then a border-t border-white/10 list of four .svc-row group rows: each = grid grid-cols-12 items-center gap-4 border-b border-white/10 px-2 py-7 -> md:px-6 md:py-9, containing a .svc-num col-span-2 -> md:col-span-1 text-[14px] font-700 text-off/35 index ('01'-'04'), a .archivo-tight col-span-10 -> md:col-span-5 text-[clamp(1.6rem,3.4vw,2.6rem)] font-800 title, a .svc-tags col-span-12 -> md:col-span-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2 of rounded-full border border-white/20 text-[12px] uppercase tag chips, and a hidden md:flex md:col-span-1 justify-end .svc-arrow lucide:arrow-right. The signature interaction: .svc-row:hover { background:#c4ff00; color:#0c0c0c } and on hover the index, arrow, and tag chip borders/text all flip to noir. Rows: '01 Web & Product Design [Figma / Design Systems / Prototyping]', '02 Brand Identity [Logo & Marks / Type / Guidelines]', '03 Webflow & Framer Build [No-code / CMS / SEO]', '04 Motion & Art Direction [Animation / 3D / Campaign]'.

section id=clients relative border-t border-white/10 py-20 -> md:py-28; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8. Header (flex flex-col gap-4 -> md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between): left = a text-lime eyebrow '(Trusted by / 04)' + an H2 .archivo-tight text-[clamp(1.6rem,3.6vw,2.8rem)] font-800 'Brands and juries that kept us busy.'; right = a flex flex-wrap gap-3 of three award pills (rounded-full border ... px-4 py-2 text-[12px] uppercase) each with a lucide icon: a lime-bordered/lime-text 'Awwwards · SOTD ×6' (lucide:award), then white/15-bordered off/60 'CSS Design · ×4' (lucide:trophy) and 'FWA · ×4' (lucide:star). Below: a logo grid mt-12 grid grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-4 -> lg:grid-cols-6 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/10 (so gap-px reads as hairline dividers); each cell is a flex items-center justify-center bg-noir py-10 with a .archivo-tight text-[22px] font-800 text-off/55 wordmark (Northwind, Lumio, Cobalt, Verdant, Atlas, Keystone, Halo Labs, Driftwood, Monocle, Pivot, Solace) and a final text-lime '+ you' cell.

section id=contact relative .grain overflow-hidden border-t border-white/10 py-28 -> md:py-40; mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 -> md:px-8; text-center. A text-lime eyebrow '(Let''s build / 05)', then a huge H2 .display mx-auto mt-6 max-w-[14ch] text-[clamp(3rem,12vw,11rem)] 'Got a brand' / (block) 'to [launch? in text-lime]', a mx-auto mt-8 max-w-xl text-[17px] text-off/65 subline 'Tell us where you want to be and we''ll map the design to get you there. First reply within a day, no sales-y nonsense.', and a CTA row (mt-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 -> sm:flex-row): a .pill-btn bg-lime text-noir 'hello@voltkind.studio' mailto pill with a lucide:arrow-up-right (hover:bg-off), and a .pill-btn border border-white/20 text-off 'Book a 20-min intro' pill with a lucide:calendar (hover:border-lime hover:text-lime), both rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-[15px] uppercase tracking-wide.

footer border-t border-white/10 bg-coal; inner mx-auto max-w-[1320px] px-5 py-16 -> md:px-8. A grid grid-cols-1 gap-12 -> md:grid-cols-12: (md:col-span-5) the brand lockup repeated (lime diamond circle + 'VOLTKIND.' .archivo-tight font-800) + a max-w-sm text-[15px] text-off/55 blurb + a status line 'Booking projects for Q3 2026' with a h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-lime dot; (md:col-span-2) a 'Studio' column (text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-off/40 heading + a space-y-2.5 list of text-off/70 .link-underline links Work/About/Services/Contact); (md:col-span-2) a 'Social' column (Instagram/Dribbble/X-Twitter/LinkedIn); (md:col-span-3) a 'Get the brief' column with a note + a newsletter form = a flex overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-white/15 with a transparent email input and a bg-lime text-noir submit button (lucide:arrow-right, hover:bg-off). Bottom: a mt-14 flex flex-col -> md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-white/10 pt-7 text-[13px] text-off/40 row = '© 2026 Voltkind Studio. All rights reserved.' / 'Designed in the dark, built for the light.' with a text-lime '✦' / 'Privacy · Terms'.

special_ui_components.component: Anton condensed display headline with an italic lime script word (.display + .script-accent)
special_ui_components.description: The page's whole identity: enormous condensed all-caps Anton headlines (hero 'WE BUILD BOLD brands ONLINE.', the CTA 'Got a brand to launch?') with one word swapped to an italic, heavy, lime Archivo word tucked inline at 0.6em, mixing brutalist scale with a handwritten-feeling pop.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .display { font-family:'Anton',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:0.86; text-transform:uppercase } and .script-accent { font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-style:italic; font-weight:800 }. Set the hero H1 to .display text-[clamp(3.4rem,15.5vw,15rem)] text-off across three lines, and inside it place a brands. Reuse .display for the big section headers and the CTA (text-[clamp(3rem,12vw,11rem)]), always with one word in text-lime or text-off/30.

special_ui_components.description: The one filled control style: fully-rounded pills that lift on hover, used in the nav ('Start a project'), the hero ('View selected work'), and the CTA ('hello@...'); the secondary variant is a bordered ghost pill that turns lime on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build .pill-btn { transition:transform .3s ease, background .3s ease, color .3s ease } and .pill-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px) }. Primary = rounded-full bg-lime text-noir font-700 uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-off (sizes px-5 py-2.5 in nav, px-6 py-3.5 in hero, px-8 py-4 in CTA). Secondary/ghost = rounded-full border border-white/20 text-off font-600 hover:border-lime hover:text-lime. Never color it any hue but lime.

special_ui_components.description: Rounded-2xl portfolio image cards where the photo scales on hover while a dark gradient meta panel slides up to reveal the project title and a lime arrow circle; below the image an always-visible label row keeps the card readable at rest and in screenshots.
special_ui_components.prompt: Card = <a class='work-card group relative block overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-slate2'>. Image wrapper aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden with .card-img { transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), filter .6s ease } and .work-card:hover .card-img { transform:scale(1.05); filter:saturate(1.1) brightness(.92) }. Overlay = .card-meta absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-noir/90 via-noir/20 to-transparent p-6, with .card-meta { transition:opacity .45s ease, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) }, starting opacity-0 translate-y-3 and going opacity-100 translate-y-0 on .work-card:hover; it holds a big .archivo-tight title, a category line, and an h-11 w-11 rounded-full bg-lime text-noir lucide:arrow-up-right circle. Keep a separate always-visible px-6 py-5 label row beneath the image.

special_ui_components.component: Hover-fill services rows (.svc-row) + animated link underline (.link-underline)
special_ui_components.description: Full-width numbered service rows that flip to a solid lime fill with noir text on hover (index, arrow, and tag-chip borders all invert), plus a reusable lime underline that wipes in from the left under text links.
special_ui_components.prompt: Rows: .svc-row { transition:background .35s ease, padding .35s ease } and .svc-row:hover { background:#c4ff00; color:#0c0c0c }; on hover also flip children: .svc-row:hover .svc-num, .svc-row:hover .svc-arrow { color:#0c0c0c } and .svc-row:hover .svc-tags span { border-color:#0c0c0c; color:#0c0c0c }. Links: .link-underline { background-image:linear-gradient(#c4ff00,#c4ff00); background-size:0% 2px; background-repeat:no-repeat; background-position:0 100%; transition:background-size .4s ease } and .link-underline:hover { background-size:100% 2px }.

special_ui_components.description: A full-bleed coal band of capability keywords separated by lime '✦' stars that scrolls horizontally forever; the keyword list is duplicated so the loop is seamless.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrapper overflow-hidden border-y border-white/10 bg-coal py-4. Track = .marquee flex w-max items-center gap-10 whitespace-nowrap with .marquee { animation:marquee 28s linear infinite } and @keyframes marquee { from { transform:translateX(0) } to { transform:translateX(-50%) } }. Put the same flex group of keyword spans (text-[15px] font-700 uppercase tracking-wide text-off/70) TWICE inside the track, the second copy aria-hidden, with text-lime '✦' separators.

special_ui_components.description: Texture instead of color: a faint SVG fractal-noise grain overlay on the hero and CTA sections, plus a single soft lime radial glow behind the hero, giving depth on the near-black canvas without adding a second hue.
special_ui_components.prompt: .grain::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:0.04; z-index:1; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,...feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency=0.9 numOctaves=3...") } applied to the hero and contact sections. The hero also gets a pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 top-10 h-[480px] w-[480px] rounded-full bg-lime/10 blur-[120px] glow. No colored gradients beyond lime/10.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive dark agency/studio marketing homepage (no browser chrome / no device frame). Every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1320px] with px-5 -> md:px-8 and sections are split by 1px border-white/10 hairlines. Built with the Tailwind CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering custom colors (noir #0c0c0c, coal #141414, slate2 #1c1c1c, off #f5f5f0, lime #c4ff00) and the three font families (Anton, Archivo, Inter); Google Fonts loads Anton + Archivo 400-900 + Inter 300-700; icons are Iconify Lucide (lucide:) glyphs via the iconify web component. Responsive contract: the floating pill nav drops its center links below lg; the hero copy row is grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-12 (lead col-span-7, CTAs col-span-5 right-aligned); the studio block is 1 -> md:grid-cols-12 with stats grid-cols-2 -> md:grid-cols-4; the work grid is 1 -> md:grid-cols-2 (the wide card md:col-span-2, aspect-[16/9] -> md:aspect-[21/8]); service rows stay a 12-col grid that stacks tags below the title on mobile; the awards grid is grid-cols-2 -> md:4 -> lg:6; the footer is 1 -> md:grid-cols-12 (5/2/2/3); body is overflow-x-hidden. All copy and the 'VOLTKIND' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped. The transferable library value is (1) the STYLE: a near-monochrome noir #0c0c0c canvas with off-white #f5f5f0 text and a SINGLE rationed acid-lime #c4ff00 accent (pills, logo diamond, '✦' stars, section index eyebrows, one word per headline, work-card arrows, the services hover-fill, stat suffixes, the link-underline), atmosphere from SVG grain + one lime/10 blur glow rather than extra color; and (2) the LAYOUT: a floating pill glass nav -> grain hero with an Anton condensed headline + inline italic lime script word + a keyword marquee -> stat-counter studio statement -> 2-col rounded-card work grid with hover-reveal meta -> hover-fill numbered services list -> awards/clients hairline logo grid -> huge centered CTA -> 4-column footer with a newsletter pill. Strictly one accent hue (lime): never introduce red/blue/violet.
